title: Reporting Subscription Coverage
description: Exceptions to one principal-level reporting subscription's coverage of one account (experimental, media_buy.reporting_subscriptions), returned in get_reporting_status. Coverage itself is computable by the buyer without asking: each confirmed buy is owed every complete period of the resolved offering's schedule, in the account's timezone, that starts on or after the later of the subscription version's accepted_at and the buy's confirmed_at, through the buy's final period. The seller reports only exceptions, and each exception only removes periods from that expectation over the half-open boundary interval [from, until); none adds one. Readable only while the caller is authorized for the account; loss of authority is reported in the caller's own get_principal subscription state.

ReportingSubscriptionExclusionReason.title: Reporting Subscription Exclusion Reason
ReportingSubscriptionExclusionReason.description: offering_unsupported: no offering matching the selector is available on this account's or buy's products. capacity: refused for a seller limit such as max_accounts. overridden: a sync_accounts delivery config, or an account_ids subscription replacing an all-accounts one, takes this account and feed_purpose. excluded_by_buyer: listed in exclude_account_ids. action_required: not served until pending_action completes.

status.description: Current account-level state. active: no account-level exclusion is in effect; individual buys may still be excluded. excluded: an open account-level excluded entry is in effect. action_required: an open account-level entry with reason action_required is in effect and pending_action says what must happen.

pending_action.description: What must happen before the seller serves this account. Present when and only when status is action_required.

excluded.description: Exceptions that remove periods. An entry without media_buy_id applies to the whole account. Retained for status_retention_days after until.

from.description: Period boundary from which periods are removed.

until.description: Period boundary at which the exception ended. Absent while still in effect.

overridden_by.description: The sync_accounts delivery config or subscription that takes this account. Present when and only when reason is overridden.

gaps.description: Intervals between a loss of authority and re-grant that the seller did not backfill (backfill_on_regrant false or absent). Periods in [from, until) are not owed. With backfill_on_regrant true no gap is recorded. Retained for status_retention_days after until.

from.description: Last period boundary at or before unauthorized_at.

until.description: First period boundary at or after the re-grant.
